known_limitations_to_disclose: EXT_SOURCE values are anonymised Home Credit scores, not Equifax scores. Equifax bands are an approximate translation.
Amounts are in dataset currency units, not AUD. The assumed interest rate is illustrative.
AMT_GOODS_PRICE has a risk spike at exactly 450,000 (one loan product, about 20,800 training rows at 13.7% default).
ANNUITY_CREDIT has a risk spike for repayment-to-loan ratios of 0.0466 to 0.0497 (one loan product, 14.7% default). With the assumed rate, a 24-month term lands here.
The target is a payment-difficulty proxy, not a Basel 90+ DPD default. Output is an estimated probability of payment difficulty.
Trained on Home Credit applicants aged 20 to 69. Illustrative portfolio model, not a production lending model.
Fix for both spikes: monotonic binning constraint, planned for notebook 03.
